name: Premium · bag alone in a real place
summary: Film-photo still life: the bag alone on an old window sill against a colour-blocked plaster wall in open shade, warm grade and grain; slow push-in; 60% empty wall for the price + COD text.
why_it_wins: Songmont 'Luna' (97 days, score 77.6): no person, no text, a real-looking place, complementary colour block so the bag is the only neutral. Reads as a magazine photo, not an ad.

beats.scene: An old ochre plaster wall with a weathered blue-green wooden window shutter and a deep stone sill, soft open-shade daylight, warm film grade with fine grain, Mediterranean medina feel
beats.composition: an empty stretch of the stone sill in the lower third where an object will be placed later

beats.motion: The product stays still; only a curtain edge and the light move slightly

dos: Keep 60% of the frame as empty wall for text
donts: No other objects on the sill
